capabilities: connect to Microsoft To Do or TickTick using a user-created OAuth application
fetch a selected remote task list into a sidebar with create, edit, complete, and reopen actions
push top-level checkbox lines from a note as remote tasks
organize tasks from all notes into a managed section in Tasks List.md
delete completed remote tasks after a confirmation dialog
disambiguation: Not a bidirectional file synchronizer; it fetches a remote list into a sidebar and pushes checkbox lines to the provider without editing Markdown.
extras: Desktop-only (OAuth uses Electron APIs, so it cannot run on mobile); requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; README discloses AI-assisted development and notes TickTick tasks cannot be reopened via its API.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to connect note checkboxes to tasks in Microsoft To Do or TickTick.

requires.name: user-created OAuth application credentials (client ID, secret, redirect URL)

summary: Task sidebar and commands that sync Markdown checkbox tasks with a Microsoft To Do or TickTick list via OAuth.
